about.title: About StackKit DevStudio
about.missionText: StackKit DevStudio was built to provide software engineers, QA analysts, and students with a modern, fast, and secure developer workstation. We replace cluttered, insecure online utilities with a unified interface housing 40+ client-side tools.
about.securityText: Unlike conventional online utilities that send your data, JSON payloads, and tokens to remote backend servers, StackKit executes 100% of its functions in your local browser using the native Web Cryptography API. Your data never leaves your device.
about.standardsText: All utilities adhere strictly to published specifications: RFC 7519 for JWT, RFC 8259 for JSON, RFC 4648 for Base64, and official regulatory algorithms including Receita Federal fiscal standards and CNJ Resolution 65/2008 for lawsuit identifiers.

compliance.aboutSubtitle: The Definitive Workstation for Modern Developers
compliance.missionDesc: StackKit DevStudio was built with a clear purpose: to provide the fastest, most reliable, and beautifully engineered workstation for software engineers, QA professionals, and digital creators worldwide. We eliminate invasive ads, bloated interfaces, and slow tools that transmit sensitive data to mystery servers.
compliance.pillarPrivacyDesc: All computing — from fiscal check digits and JWT tokens to conversions and hashes — executes in your local browser runtime via Web Crypto and native JS.
compliance.pillarPerformanceDesc: Engineered with React and Vite. Zero server latency, sub-millisecond responsiveness, and full keyboard navigation (Ctrl+K) for high productivity.
compliance.pillarStandardsDesc: Comprehensive support for Brazilian fiscal specifications (CPF, Alphanumeric CNPJ, INSS, CNJ) and global RFC standards.
compliance.contactDesc: Have a feature request, new tool suggestion, or bug report? We would love to hear from you.
compliance.privacyHighlight1Desc: Your inputs, codes, passwords, and documents are processed locally and never sent to our servers.
compliance.privacyHighlight2Desc: Full respect for user privacy rights and strict data minimization.
compliance.privacySec1Desc: At StackKit DevStudio (available at https://stackkit.com.br), accessible to developers and professionals worldwide, the privacy of our visitors is one of our main priorities. This Privacy Policy document outlines the types of information collected and recorded by StackKit and how we use it.
compliance.privacySec2P1: Unlike conventional web platforms, StackKit was engineered with a strict client-side technical architecture. When you use tools such as the CPF Generator, CNPJ Validator, JWT Inspector, JSON Formatter, Password Generator, or Canadian Citizenship Test Simulator, all mathematical algorithms, syntax parsers, and cryptographic key derivations execute strictly within your local browser JavaScript engine.
compliance.privacySec2P2: No JWT tokens, source code, JSON payloads, confidential text, or document numbers entered by you are ever transmitted to our servers or third parties.
compliance.privacySec3P1: StackKit displays advertisements served by Google AdSense to fund ongoing hosting, development, and ensure all developer utilities remain 100% free of charge.
compliance.privacySec3Item1: Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on a user's prior visits to your website or other websites.
compliance.privacySec3Item2: Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads to users based on their visits to this site and/or other sites on the Internet.
compliance.privacySec3Item3Prefix: Users may opt out of personalized advertising by visiting Google Ads Settings at:

compliance.privacySec4Desc: Like most websites, our hosting platform collects standard log files. Information recorded includes internet protocol (IP) addresses, browser type, Internet Service Provider (ISP), date and time stamp, referring/exit pages, and click counts. These metrics are not linked to personally identifiable information and serve exclusively to analyze platform performance and prevent malicious traffic.
compliance.privacySec5Desc: StackKit utilizes your browser's native LocalStorage strictly to store your interface preferences: selected theme (dark or light), preferred language (Portuguese, English, or Spanish), sidebar state, and your list of favorited tools. No LocalStorage data is ever synchronized or transmitted remotely.
compliance.privacySec6Desc: In accordance with Brazil's Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (Law No. 13.709/2018 - LGPD) and the European Union General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), we ensure full transparency, rights of access, and instant cookie consent revocation.
compliance.privacySec7Desc: If you have questions or require further clarification regarding our Privacy Policy, please contact our team at: contato@stackkit.com.br.
compliance.termsSec1Desc: By accessing and utilizing StackKit DevStudio (https://stackkit.com.br), you agree to comply with and be bound by these Terms of Service. If you disagree with any portion of these terms, please discontinue using our platform.
compliance.termsSec2P1: StackKit DevStudio provides utilities for generating mathematical documents and identifiers (such as CPF, CNPJ, RG, INSS Benefit Numbers, CNJ Lawsuits, and Synthetic Credit Cards). All these tools exist strictly to assist software engineers, QA professionals, students, and analysts with system validation, unit testing, and form debugging.
compliance.termsSec2NoticeText: Generated numbers DO NOT represent real persons or entities and hold zero legal, tax, or commercial value. Using any data generated on this platform for unlawful conduct, impersonation, fraudulent transactions, or commercial deception is strictly forbidden.
compliance.termsSec3Desc: StackKit implements recognized open standards (such as RFC 7519 for JWT, RFC 8259 for JSON, RFC 4648 for Base64, and official public algorithms). The platform design and software implementation are protected by copyright and intellectual property legislation.
compliance.termsSec4Desc: The service is provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis without warranties of any kind. StackKit makes no representations regarding uninterrupted access or absolute infallibility of third-party network APIs.

doc.title: How does the INSS Benefit Number (NB) work?
doc.desc: The Benefit Number (NB) is a 10-digit unique identifier assigned by the Brazilian Social Security Institute (INSS) to each granted welfare or retirement benefit (such as retirement, disability, pension, or maternity allowance).
doc.structureDesc: Composed of 9 sequential digits followed by 1 final verification check digit in format: 000.000.000-0.
doc.calcDesc: The first 9 digits are multiplied by weights [2, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2]. The modulo 11 remainder establishes the DV.
doc.testingDesc: Tool developed exclusively for software testing, quality assurance, and development. Generated numbers hold no real-world entitlement.

doc.title: Unified Lawsuit Numbering Standard (CNJ)
doc.desc: Established by Resolution No. 65/2008 of the Brazilian National Justice Council (CNJ), the unified numbering system for judicial lawsuits consists of 20 digits organized into 6 fields:
doc.fieldA: Year the lawsuit was originally filed.
doc.fieldJ: Branch or segment of Judiciary (1 to 9).
doc.fieldTR: Court or judicial regional circuit ID.
doc.fieldO: Court branch or judicial unit of origin.
